name: Word Punch
description: One huge word at a time types on behind its full stop and deletes from the front, or punches in.

name: Letter Flip
description: Each letter swings in from its mirror image and lands in turn.

name: Ribbon Words
description: A bold white ribbon draws a big S down a black frame, carrying a short phrase that settles mid-ribbon and drifts, then rides off as the ribbon retracts.

name: Chunky Type Stack

name: Coming Soon Flips
description: Condensed words with a growing underline hard cut between ink and tangerine plates, one flickering through typefaces, then a tracked-in title while slatted light sweeps a plaster wall to reveal a logo.
